notes: RCL Foods Limited (JSE: RCL) — South African diversified food group ~77% owned by Remgro (RMH). Operates across multiple segments: Sugar (TSB, Selati — cane-growing + milling), Chicken (Rainbow brand — under unbundling/separate-listing review), Groceries (Nola, Pieman's, Yum Yum, Ouma), Pies, Pet Food (Bobtail, Canine Cuisine, Ultra), Vector Logistics (cold-chain). Fiscal year ends 30 June. Significant restructuring underway through FY24: separately listed Rainbow Chicken (RBO) on JSE June 2024 (RCL retained nil stake post-unbundling); Vector Logistics divestment FY25. Sugar margins highly volatile (RSA Health Promotion Levy / sugar tax + global sugar prices). Annual reports / SENS at rclfoods.com/investors.

periods.notes: FY20: revenue R27.1B. COVID disruption. Underlying EBITDA ~R1.75B. Sugar improving on cane volumes.
FY21: revenue R28.5B. EBITDA R2.3B (+31%). Sugar segment profitable. KZN July riots disrupted Q1 FY22 but FY21 strong. Dividend 30 cents resumed.
FY22: revenue R30.8B. EBITDA R2.65B. Op profit R1.59B. KZN floods + riots impact partly absorbed. Sugar strong.
FY23: revenue R36.1B (+17%) — pricing pass-through. Chicken hit by HPAI / load-shedding (~R200M+ diesel). Sugar resilient. EBITDA dropped to R2.2B. HEPS ~107 cents.

FY24: revenue R36.8B. Underlying EBITDA R3.3B (+50% — chicken recovery, sugar stable). Rainbow Chicken (RBO) unbundled and separately listed June 2024 — these continuing-ops figures exclude Rainbow post-unbundling and reflect group basis pre-spin. HEPS ~145 cents. Dividend 65 cents.
